title: RiboNet deep learning reveals sequence-dependent translation recovery in yeast
summary: RiboNet, a deep learning model predicting ribosome load and position from mRNA sequence, was used with ribosome profiling, metabolomics and proteomics in budding yeast. RiboNet-guided in silico mutagenesis indicated reduced pausing at serine codons after glucose repletion and transiently increased pausing at leucine codons after nitrogen repletion. It also identified a conserved 5' UTR motif, GAUY, that increased reporter output after glucose repletion. Only the abstract was reviewed, and one motif was reporter-tested.
ai_technology: RiboNet deep learning model of ribosome load from mRNA sequence, with in silico mutagenesis
